description.Name: An open fMRI dataset examining the effects of online social and non-social information distraction on global-local attention

latestSnapshot.readme:
This dataset contains the raw MRI data accompanying the paper "An open fMRI dataset examining the effects of online social and non-social information distraction on global-local attention". Please cite the above paper if you use this data.

The dataset includes:

1. anat/ anatomical scans (T1-weighted images) for each subject
2. func/ whole-brain EPI data from 3 task runs per participant. 

The events files contain the onsets, durations, trial types  for all trials in the corresponding run. 


For a full description of the paradigm and the employed procedures please see the paper.
